verdict.rationale: Medusa's own Cloud offering lists "Background workers", and a community comment confirms Medusa runs background workers that process queued jobs outside a request's lifetime. That shows the product executes work in the background, but nothing shows how users configure or schedule their own autonomous automations. missing for 10: documentation of user-defined background automations or scheduled/recurring jobs, how to trigger and configure them, any agent-driven autonomous execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: We use background workers to process jobs from a Bull queue that may not finish within a request's lifetime.
